retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, grainy duotone portrait featuring a subject with wet, textured hair and a candid, downward-looking pose, overlaid with clean, semi-transparent serif typography.
triggerTerms: grainy film portrait with serif overlay

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, high-contrast photograph of a woman with dark, wet, curly hair looking downward. The image uses a muted, sepia-toned duotone palette with heavy film grain. The subject is positioned diagonally, creating a sense of intimacy and movement. A clean, lowercase serif nameplate is placed in the upper right quadrant, partially overlapping the background elements.
coreVisualRelationships: High contrast between dark wet hair and pale skin tones
Diagonal composition of the subject's body and head
Juxtaposition of organic, messy hair textures against clean, structured typography
Muted, monochromatic color palette creating a nostalgic mood
coreInvariants: Wet, stringy hair texture across the face

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject's head and shoulders occupy the lower left and center, angled diagonally upward toward the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eye and the dark mass of wet hair.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the diagonal line of the subject's arm and neck up to the typography in the top right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper right background and lower left foreground provide areas of lighter, blown-out space.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Creamy off-white for highlights and skin tones
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep charcoal/black for hair and shadows
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation, high value contrast; the image relies on tonal range rather than hue.

composition.scale: Large enough to be a primary identifier

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for minimalist impact.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high contrast and elegant serifs.
Provides the vertical stress and refined look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, grainy duotone photograph of a woman with dark, wet, curly hair looking down. The lighting should be harsh, blowing out highlights on the skin while keeping deep shadows in the hair. The composition should be diagonal.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a lowercase modern serif nameplate in the upper right quadrant using a semi-transparent muted lavender-grey color.

verificationChecks: Is the hair visibly wet and textured?
Is the typography lowercase and serif?
Is the image grainy and high-contrast?
Is the color palette restricted to a duotone/sepia feel?

mustRedesign: Do not use the specific name from the original image
Do not replicate the exact background architecture
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible despite transparency
Check that the grain doesn't obscure facial features
Verify the diagonal composition feels balanced
Confirm the duotone effect is consistent across the frame
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine high-contrast film portraiture + wet hair styling + lowercase modern serif typography + duotone color grading.
